name: @floatty/render-door
description: Render door for floatty — @json-render/solid catalog + registry + components. Consumed by the floatty Tauri app at runtime (loaded from ~/.floatty{,-dev}/doors/render/index.js) and by the render-reference contract harness at compile time.

scripts.build: node ../../apps/floatty/scripts/compile-door-bundle.mjs src/render.tsx dist/index.js && cp door.json dist/door.json
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm run build && mkdir -p ~/.floatty-dev/doors/render && cp dist/index.js ~/.floatty-dev/doors/render/index.js && cp dist/door.json ~/.floatty-dev/doors/render/door.json
scripts.deploy:all: pnpm run build && mkdir -p ~/.floatty-dev/doors/render ~/.floatty/doors/render && cp dist/index.js ~/.floatty-dev/doors/render/index.js && cp dist/door.json ~/.floatty-dev/doors/render/door.json && cp dist/index.js ~/.floatty/doors/render/index.js && cp dist/door.json ~/.floatty/doors/render/door.json
